name: terminal-mate
description: Custom command snippets, history, and status bar shortcuts for terminal workflows. Automate repetitive shell commands with intelligent placeholders.

title.description: Label in the menu and name of the terminal. Chains and keybindings refer to a command by this title.

reuse.description: Override terminal reuse behavior for this snippet

os.description: Limit snippet to specific operating systems (win32|darwin|linux)

chain.description: Use instead of "command": titles of saved commands to run one after another in the same terminal. The chain stops at the first step that fails.

group.description: Group name. Commands with the same group are shown together under a heading in the menu.

archived.description: Hide this command from the main list. Archived commands stay available under the Archive item at the bottom.

terminal-mate.customTerminalsButtonLabel.description: Status Bar button label that opens the saved custom commands Quick Pick

enumDescriptions: Your own order, changed with the Move up / Move down buttons
terminal-mate.sortCommands.description: Order of commands in the menu (applied inside each group)

terminal-mate.cursorSymbol.description: Marker inside snippets for manual cursor placement before finishing the command

terminal-mate.showPreviewForCustomTermin.description: Show a modal preview of the final command before running

terminal-mate.reuseTerminalByTitle.description: Reuse existing terminal windows matched by snippet title

terminal-mate.customHistorySize.description: Maximum number of executed commands to keep in history

terminal-mate.confirmDangerousCommands.description: Ask for confirmation before running a command that matches one of the dangerous command patterns

terminal-mate.dangerousCommandPatterns.markdownDescription: Regular expressions (case-insensitive) for commands that need confirmation before they run. Add your own, for example `rms+-rf` or `drops+database`.

terminal-mate.pinLastCustomTerminal.description: Pin the most recently used command to the status bar for one-click access

terminal-mate.pinLastCustomTerminalLabel.description: Prefix used for the pinned last-command status bar button

terminal-mate.showStatusBar.description: Show the TerminalMate menu button in the status bar

terminal-mate.saveCommandsToWorkspace.description: When enabled, new and edited commands are saved to workspace settings instead of global settings. Requires an open workspace folder.
